content.comment_body: I've tried to buy this [product_name], but the website doesn't seem to give me the necessary access. After upgrading to a new desktop without a disk drive, I can't locate the license on the disk, and attempting to purchase through this site hasn't worked for me.
I can access the disk using my old desktop, but still can't find the license.
Hi [user_name], I recommend contacting [company_name] support by submitting a Support Request. They should be able to assist you.

[product_name] does not use a license like some other software such as [product_name]. The installation CD (DVD) itself serves as the license. If you have the installation CD (DVD), you can upgrade to [product_name] [version_no]. The upgrade is available for download—search for firmware updates and service packs for your device. Instructions to install the upgrade are available in the relevant FAQ for installing downloaded upgrades with or without existing [product_name] software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter challenges when purchasing or upgrading [product_name], mainly because the licensing relies on physical installation disks and website restrictions prevent easy online upgrade or purchase. The lack of an obvious license code and dependency on outdated hardware complicate transitions to new computers without disk drives. Uncertainties about the software's licensing method lead to confusion during upgrades.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easier method to buy and upgrade [product_name] [version_no] online, as well as a straightforward way to transfer or recover their software license without relying on physical media or license codes.
